steps.request_body: HelPhone connects you with people nearby when you're in an emergency. You can request help or offer help to others. Everything runs on Stellar — fast, public, and verifiable.
steps.receipt_body: When you request or offer help, Stellar confirms it in seconds. That creates a public transaction hash — your receipt.
steps.wallet_body: Your Stellar wallet only signs transactions — it's not a tracking tool. Connect to request help, offer help, or verify your identity on the network.
